headline: PHONE TAKES GET HONEST — THE FLUSH WAS STEALING THE TAIL
lede: Jon's first three iPhone GAUNTLET runs failed the evidence check with audio shorter than its own clock and zero human seats. Both causes were in the capture, not the phone: the track length was stamped before the encoder's final chunk landed, and the training label called a thumb a model.

notes.text: voiceCapture now stamps the audio length when stop() FINISHES, not when it is called — iPhone Safari's flush latency (up to 1.6 s) always outran the old stamp, so every phone take looked short. Desktop Chrome flushes instantly; that is why the synth harness stayed green while real phone bytes failed.

Seat 0 of a consented auto-capture is now labeled `human` at origin — Gauntlet's seat table said `model` (true for the harness, a lie for a thumb), and it poisoned every training label. Rally keeps its own honest labels via an opt-out.

Evidence now reports replay and voice separately, prints track-ms vs clock-ms side by side, and reads the duration the CONTAINER declares (new WebM/mp4 byte parser) — so the next phone take says numerically whether iOS dropped the tail or the clock lied. The check itself was not loosened.

The harness learned the phone's shape: three synthetic takes (mic opens late, slow flush, mp4 container) with two mutants that go red naming their milliseconds. 32/32 self-test, 115/115 recordcheck, 49/49 voicecheck, prod marker verified live.
